items.title: Exercise special termination right (price increase) with provider
items.quote: Für diese Kündigung haben Sie drei Monate Zeit, gerechnet ab dem Zugang dieser Mitteilung; wirksam wird sie frühestens an dem Tag, an dem der neue Preis gilt.
items.computation: The letter is dated Saturday, 21.11.2026 (confirmed: 2026-11-21 falls on a Saturday). It would normally be posted on the next business day (Monday, 23.11.2026); since today, 24.11.2026, is the date this letter is being processed by the recipient, the most plausible assumption is that Zugang (receipt) occurred on 24.11.2026 (standard 1 business-day postal transit). No statutory postal-fiction clause is printed in the letter, so this is an estimate, not a certainty. Per §187 Abs. 1 BGB, because the period is triggered by an event (Zugang), the day of the event itself (24.11.2026) is not counted; the period starts 25.11.2026. Per §188 Abs. 2 BGB, a period of months ends with the expiry of the day of the last month that bears the same number as the day on which the triggering event (Zugang) occurred, i.e. the 24th. Three months after 24.11.2026 is 24.02.2027. Checking the weekday of 24.02.2027: it falls on a Wednesday, so no §193 BGB extension is needed. The cancellation becomes effective at the earliest on 01.01.2027 (when the new price starts), but must simply reach the provider by 24.02.2027 to exercise the special right at all.
